subject: general
question: P and Q together can fill a cistern with water in 12 hours. If P alone can fill the cistern with water in 48 hours, then in how many hours will Q alone fill one-fourth of the same cistern with water?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

P + Q = 1/12, P = 1/48

⇒ Q = 1/12 − 1/48 = 3/48 = 1/16

Q fills full tank in 16 hours

⇒ 1/4 tank time = 16/4 = 4 hours

**∴ Answer = 4 hours**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

P + Q can fill tank in 12 hours

P alone can fill tank in 48 hours

**Formula used:**

Work rate = Work ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ (P + Q)’s rate = 1/12

⇒ P’s rate = 1/48

⇒ Q’s rate = (1/12 − 1/48)

⇒ = (4 − 1)/48 = 3/48 = 1/16

⇒ Time taken by Q for full tank = 16 hours

⇒ Time for 1/4 tank = 16 ÷ 4 = 4 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 4 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Work Rate Concept

Rate = 1 / Time

Combined Work

Add individual rates when working together

Partial Work

Time ∝ Work (for constant rate)

Quick Tip

Find full time first, then scale for fraction
